Six public results: (1) abelSummation - the finite Abel/partial-summation identity for aSeq, fSeq : N -> C on any segment [a, a+L) (pure algebra, induction on L, Finset range/Ico bookkeeping); (2) etaDiffBound - for 0 < Re s and 0 < n, ||n^{-s} - (n+1)^{-s}|| <= ||s|| * n^{-(Re s + 1)} (mean-value bound via HasDerivAt.cpow_const + HasDerivAt.comp_ofReal + norm_sub_le_integral_of_norm_deriv_le_of_le, real line segment, antitoneOn_rpow_Ioi_of_exponent_nonpos for the rpow integrand bound); (3) etaNormPow - ||k^s|| = (k : R)^{Re s} for k > 0; (4) etaAltPartialBound - |sum_{k<=m} (-1)^k| <= 1 (the alternating-partial-sum bound, used to bound the Abel endpoint sums); (5) etaTailBound - for 0 < Re s and 1 <= N <= M, ||P_M - P_N|| <= (2 + ||s||/Re s) * N^{-Re s}: the segment sum is Abel-decomposed into two endpoint sums (bounded by the alternating-partial-sum bound) plus a difference sum bounded termwise by etaDiffBound, then the decreasing sum is bounded by the integral of x^{-(Re s + 1)} on (N, inf) via AntitoneOn.summable_of_integrableOn_Ioi + AntitoneOn.tsum_comp_add_le_integral + the local OnlineZeta integralIoiRpowNeg (= N^{-Re s}/Re s), and the endpoint M^(-Re s) is folded into N^{-Re s} by antitonality (rpowNegAntitone on [1, inf)). (6) etaPartialSumsCauchy - for 0 < Re s, CauchySeq (fun N => P_N): given epsilon, the tail bound with c = 2 + ||s||/Re s gives N^{-Re s} < epsilon/c eventually (tendsto_rpow_neg_atTop + tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop + Filter.mem_map'), and the m <= n / n <= m cases follow from etaTailBound with the appropriate (M, N) order.

PROOF-ENGINEERING NOTES (recorded for the resume contract): (i) the Abel decomposition bridges hraw (abelSummation's fSeq = fun k => (Nat.cast k : C)^(-s)) to the T1 - T2 + T3 form through explicit single-cast Nat.cast term forms - parenthesized ascriptions like ((N + 1 + j) : C) elaborate as DISTRIBUTED real sums (up N + 1 + up j) while beta-substituting an ascribed variable yields a SINGLE cast (up (N + 1 + j)); the two forms are propositionally equal but not definitionally, and every calc step must be written in the exact elaborated term form or rw fails; (ii) (M + 1) - 1 does NOT reduce to M definitionally under Nat.cast (stuck at sub M 0), so Nat.add_sub_cancel is needed after range-shift rewrites; (iii) AntitoneOn.mono restricts from the larger set (Ioi 0) to Ici (N : R) and needs Set.mem_ofPred_eq in the dsimp list to unfold the membership; (iv) the rpowNegAntitone lemma is stated on [1, inf) with an explicit sigma - when the expected exponent is -(s.re + 1), sigma must be pinned (sigma := s.re + 1) or linarith picks sigma := s.re and the types mismatch; the set Ici 1 vs Ici (1 : R) mismatch is bridged by .mono with Nat.cast_one; (v) Filter.Tendsto applied as a function takes the neighborhood-membership proof with the set implicit (h2 (Metric.ball_mem_nhds 0 hdelta)), and ball_mem_nhds has epsilon strict-implicit; (vi) gcongr auto-discharges goals whose witnesses are already in the local context (hMleN/hN1le), so surplus bullets must not be written.
